title: Higher Barbell Diffeomorphisms and Watanabe's Clasper Surgery
summary: Watanabe constructed many nontrivial family diffeomorphisms in $π_*\text{Diff}_\partial(D^4)$, which were obtained by doing clasper surgeries on trivalent graphs. In this paper, we generalize the barbell diffeomorphism discovered by Budney and Gabai and construct a series of nontrivial elements in $π_{k-1}\text{Diff}_\partial(M_{k+1}')$ with $M_{k+1}'=\natural_{k+1} S^2\times D^2$ the $(k+1)$-cuff barbell, which we call higher barbell diffeomorphisms.
